data.heading: From Gemini Enterprise to production value

blocks.body:
Agivant Technologies launches a dedicated Gemini Enterprise practice with Google Cloud, turning ambitious AI pilots into production-grade agents that deliver real business outcomes every day.

Built on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), and production-grade architectures, we help organizations advance from early prototypes to resilient, self-orchestrating agentic environments in days and weeks.

data.heading: Get Amp'd to move from AI ambition to autonomous workflows.

blocks.body: Enterprise AI proves its worth in production, not in the pilot. Amp’d is how Agivant delivers real business value for every enterprise, bringing together Agivant’s AI Engineering toolkit: Bolt, forward-deployed engineers, production-grade AI agents, and reusable engineering assets. Together, they move AI from ambition to autonomous workflows. Every Build amplifies the next.

blocks.title:
Agentic Quote
Accelerator
blocks.body: Compress complex quoting cycles from days to minutes.
blocks.challenge: Salesforce CPQ and Oracle CPQ environments often rely heavily on rules-based logic. Complex quote cycles can stretch from 3 to 7 business days and depend on scarce SME time, quietly wearing down margin along the way.
blocks.solution: Multi-agent teams connect directly with the existing CRM. Revenue teams lead the business while agents run the process, compressing quoting cycles from days to minutes.

agents.role: Assembles quotes from products, pricing, discounts, and accounts.

agents.name: Quote Analyser
agents.role: Delivers win-rate analysis for every quote.

blocks.body: Turn fragmented procurement data into faster, smarter decisions.
blocks.challenge: Procurement teams grapple with siloed spend data, fragmented vendor contracts, and slow RFx cycles. Lack of real-time supplier intelligence leads to missed savings and high operational overhead.
blocks.solution: Autonomous procurement agent networks continuously aggregate supplier data, automate price discovery, and streamline vendor scoring, enabling data-driven negotiations and 50% faster sourcing cycles.

blocks.title:
Agentic
ZeroQueue
blocks.body: Run IT service operations with a governed, self-managing queue.
blocks.challenge: Enterprise IT service desks are overwhelmed by Tier 1 and Tier 2 ticket volume. High mean time to resolution (MTTR) burns engineering bandwidth and delays critical system access.
blocks.solution: Agentic ZeroQueue introduces self-resolving incident workflows that triage, reproduce, debug, and resolve routine IT issues autonomously while maintaining strict human-in-the-loop oversight for escalations.

agents.name: Queue Dispatcher
agents.role: Performs real-time sentiment analysis and routes critical incidents.

agents.name: Diagnostic Agent
agents.role: Collects system logs, telemetry traces, and environment metrics instantly.

agents.name: Remediation Engine
agents.role: Executes approved runbooks and infrastructure scripts safely.

agents.name: Knowledge Synthesizer
agents.role: Indexes past post-mortems to suggest resolution paths for novel errors.

agents.name: Policy Guard
agents.role: Ensures change tickets comply with ITIL change management guidelines.

agents.name: SLA Sentinel
agents.role: Monitors ticket velocity and proactively triggers automated escalation.

blocks.title: CPQ Lens
blocks.body: Accelerate CPQ migration while reducing pricing and revenue risk.
blocks.challenge: Migrating legacy CPQ rule bases to modern platforms is notoriously error-prone, requiring months of manual reverse-engineering and risking costly pricing mismatches in production.
blocks.solution: CPQ Lens reverse-engineers legacy pricing rules, validates product constraints via graph reasoning, and automatically converts rule sets into certified target schemas with zero regression.

agents.name: Rule Decompiler
agents.role: Parses legacy apex, formulas, and pricing matrices into abstract syntax trees.

agents.name: Constraint Verifier
agents.role: Validates product bundling and dependency logic with formal verification.

agents.name: Schema Converter
agents.role: Translates legacy rules into target Gemini Enterprise and Salesforce CPQ schemas.

agents.name: Regression Simulator
agents.role: Simulates millions of historical quote scenarios to guarantee zero price drift.

agents.name: Audit Reporter
agents.role: Generates comprehensive compliance matrices and migration audit trails.

agents.name: Deployment Sync
agents.role: Pushes verified rules directly to sandbox and staging environments.

proof.description: PQ migrations move at 2x speed with lower risk
